scope: 2026 ordinary domestic resident Korean company, full calendar year, initial local return, no installments or separate special-tax liabilities
implementation: Discriminated assessment contract and saved-case API combine independently established national and local bases, preserve authority-level payments and refunds, and reconcile the national base to saved gross income less established deductions and eligible losses.

reference_research.use: Previously reviewed rounding/minimum-tax design reference; no external code or dependency adopted. Legal evidence is recorded in companion Korean source reviews.

verification.business_case: KRW100m national base gives KRW10m gross national tax; KRW11m national prepayments produce KRW1m refundable. Independent KRW200m local base gives KRW2m payable across two local filing authorities. The API retains both totals without cross-authority netting.
verification.persistence: Successful result survives store restart and idempotent request replay; unverified scope is rejected before a successful run.
verification.input_boundaries: Saved subject, residency, year, deductions, confirmation and unsupported foreign/special income tested; ratio float and excessive precision rejected.
